# Pixel Stretch

**Distortion › Warp** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (10–50)

The new scene sweeps in with its leading edge smeared into long streaks, like pixels stretched by speed.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/pixel-stretch@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Music videos and fast edits
- Tech and gaming
- A sharper alternative to a whip pan

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import pixelStretch from './transitions/06-distortion/warp/pixel-stretch';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(pixelStretch, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `streak` | number | `0.4` | 0.05–0.9 | Longest streak, as a share of the frame width. |
